title: CLI-guided sample workflows and error-safety notes (draft)
body:
Purpose
-------
This is a working draft that collects a small set of hands-on CLI-first workflows we can ship in the SDK playground and the docs site. Focus: teach devs how to iterate quickly with the Redwood API/CLI, recover from the most common errors, and add defensive telemetry hooks. This intentionally skews terse — designed to be copy-paste friendly for workshop slides and the playground terminal tab.

Audience
--------
- Software engineers and ML engineers evaluating Redwood for a prototype.
- Platform engineers creating reproducible demo environments.
- Doc writers who will convert these workflows into step-by-step guides and short videos.

Goals
-----
1) Provide 4 short CLI-driven flows (30s–8min each) that a new user can run in the playground.
2) Show explicit failure modes and one-line recovery actions (so a user with 0 context can self-recover).
3) Surface hooks we need in Console/Telemetry (e.g., route-level latency tags, CLI debug flags).
4) Produce copy that can be embedded in the SDK README and the in-product onboarding carousel.

What this is not
----------------
- Not a full quickstart that covers auth, billing, and rate limits — those belong in the main "get started" doc.
- Not the final UX copy — this is raw authoring for engineers and content folks.

High-level UX patterns
----------------------
- CLI-first: commands are the primary artifact; snippets are runnable in the playground terminal.
- Idempotent examples: every command includes a token for isolation (e.g., --demo-id) so users can rerun without cleanup.
- Fail-fast guidance: for each flow we list the 2 most likely user failures and a 1-line fix.
- Observability hooks: "how to check" steps that point to Console views or the CLI --debug output.

Flow 1 — "Hello completions" (30–90s)
-----------------------------------
Goal: create a small prompt, stream responses, and capture token usage.
Commands (runnable):
- rw auth login --demo-id=cli-hello
- rw completions create --model=redwood-small --prompt='Translate to French: "Hello from Redwood"' --stream
Expected quick-checks:
- See streaming tokens in terminal.
- After command: rw usage last --demo-id=cli-hello -> shows tokens and region.
Common failures + fixes:
- 403 / unauthorized -> rw auth status (if expired: rw auth login)
- Stream stutters or incomplete output -> add --no-cache to bypass local playground prefix cache; file a GH issue if reproducible.
Telemetry/console hooks to capture:
- request_id, model_variant, tokens_out, latency_ms

Flow 2 — "Embedding search + cache" (4–6min)
--------------------------------------------
Goal: show how to create embeddings, store them locally in the playground, and do a nearest-neighbor search. Emphasize TTL and cache policy.
Commands:
- rw embeddings create --model=embed-v1 --text-file=examples/faq.txt --demo-id=emb-001
- rw embeddings store --collection=demo-faq --source=emb-001 --ttl=24h
- rw embeddings query --collection=demo-faq --text='how do I rotate keys' --topk=5
Failure modes + fixes:
- slow indexing -> show --batch-size override and point to console metrics for batch latency
- stale results -> explain TTL vs manual invalidate: rw embeddings invalidate --collection=demo-faq --id=<id>
Observability hooks:
- indexing_rate, cache_hits, approximate_memory_gb, last_index_time

Flow 3 — "A/B route fallback demo" (6–8min)
----------------------------------------
Goal: illustrate rollouts: route A (redwood-small) and fallback B (redwood-medium) when capacity is limited. Includes a simulated failure.
Commands to configure locally (playground config file is used):
- cat > playground-route.yml <<EOF
  route: demo-ab
  variants:
    - name: fast
      model: redwood-small
      weight: 80
    - name: high-qual
      model: redwood-medium
      weight: 20
  fallback_policy: prefer-region
  EOF
- rw routes apply --file=playground-route.yml --demo-id=ab-demo
- rw routes run --route=demo-ab --prompt='Summarize the paper: ...' --repeat=10
Simulated failure to demonstrate fallback:
- Inject capacity-constraint simulation: rw sim capacity --region=us-west --throttle=90% --target=redwood-small
- Re-run requests and confirm traffic shifts to redwood-medium; observe higher latency but preserved success.
One-line fixes for common problems:
- Route not found -> rw routes list --demo-id=ab-demo
- Fallback not triggering -> confirm variant compatibility in console; fallback requires compatible tokenizer/kvcache layout.
Telemetry hooks to collect:
- variant_selected, fallback_triggered, per-token-cost, route_success_rate

Flow 4 — "Retry-safe streaming & partial-output preservation" (3–5min)
------------------------------------------------------------------
Goal: show patterns for safe retries when streaming (client buffering, idempotency keys).
Pattern summary:
- Always attach --idempotency-key=<uuid> to generation calls when you intend to retry.
- Write partial outputs to local file with timestamps; on retry, pick up last offset and request continuation with --resume-offset.
Example (conceptual):
- rw completions create --model=redwood-medium --prompt-file=long-prompt.md --stream --idempotency-key=demo-stream-42 --out=partial.out
- If connection fails: rw completions resume --idempotency-key=demo-stream-42 --resume-offset=123 --out=partial.out
Failure modes:
- Missing resume support in older SDK versions -> check rw --version and show upgrade hint: pip install --upgrade redwood-rw-cli
- Duplicate output on retry -> dedupe by timestamp/sequence header included in server stream

Testing and QA checklist for docs team
-------------------------------------
- Each flow must have a validated "clean run" in the playground within 1 retry.
- Add CI job: docs/cli-playground-smoke that runs each example in a container and asserts exit code 0 and expected token counts. (JIRA: DX-587)
- Snapshot sample outputs for stable models and surface diffs if tokens deviate > 10%

Observability and metrics we need in Console/CLI
---------------------------------------------
- CLI flag: --debug=network,proto,telemetry to include request_id and server spans in stdout.
- Per-request metadata: demo-id (CLI-supplied), route, variant, idempotency-key.
- Console panes needed for playground: Live request tail (streaming), Recent fallbacks, Embedding index health.

Docs authoring notes / copy suggestions
------------------------------------
- Keep each flow to one screenful (250–400 words).
- Provide a 1-line TL;DR and a 1-min screencast for each flow.
- Encourage devs to change demo-id to their GitHub username — reduces collisions in shared sandbox.

Open questions / rough TODOs
--------------------------
- Do we want to bake --demo-id into the playground terminal automatically? Pros: fewer typos. Cons: hidden mutation of user state. (Ask UX)
- Should the CLI expose a single "rw playground run <flow>" that runs a curated set of commands in order? (nice for workshops)
- Need a canonical sample dataset for embeddings (FAQ vs Support transcripts). Who owns it? (suggest: Solutions Engineering)
- Add CI gating to ensure examples work across regions (us-west, eu-central). (Owner: Marco)

Next steps (short term)
----------------------
- Convert Flow 1 and Flow 4 into playground "launch recipes" and add to the in-product carousel (content owner: Priya).
- File infra ticket to add CLI --debug telemetry fields (ENG-xxxx).
- Implement docs smoke CI job and hook it to the docs PR pipeline (owner: Ethan).

Notes to self (rough)
--------------------
- Keep commands copy-pastable: avoid long wrapped lines and prefer explicit flags over config when possible.
- Use model aliases (redwood-small) not numeric IDs in examples to remain stable across model swaps.

Slack references / past threads
-----------------------------
- See #dx-playground: thread pinned "embedding cache policies" (2025-08-12)
- Quick demo feedback from K. Nguyen: "users get stuck if stream stalls, add resume example"

Revision history
----------------
- 2026-02-10: initial draft (A. Patel)
- 2026-02-28: added A/B route demo and telemetry checklist (Marco)
- 2026-03-10: clarified retry resume flags and CI checklist (Priya)

-- end of draft --
